title: Three Summers and One Short Bucket
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：lack　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lack 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the keeper ① measured the lack that no farmer in the village would have recorded, and he said the measuring was the whole of the summer. The ② lack, meaning the shortage itself and not the bucket, ran three summers and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lack, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lack in that village had the same short bucket beside it, and the ④ lack at the far well, meaning the drop they kept for the children to save and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lack, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lack was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the shortage. The ⑥ lack, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lack, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a shortage and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ lack had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bucket. The ⑧ lack of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in June, was one village and three summers of recording; lack, he said, is either the drop at the far well or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lack I remember is the shortage recorded in the chart, which closed in 1988 and is still recorded as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ lack, my mother said in 1990, is the only shortage that improves by being recorded; every lack, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like a shortage. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 缺乏；短缺（指村子里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 缺乏；短缺（指那种短缺本身，与水桶相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure the lack 度量这处短缺
D. n. 缺乏；短缺（指留给孩子们省下的那一滴那一种）
E. n. 匮乏之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的短缺之事）
F. n. 缺乏；短缺（指水账里写到、被记载的的那一种）
G. n. 惜护、节用（指一件事里人人都省却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 节用（抽象总称，指人人都省却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: measured the lack that no farmer in the village would have recorded

answers.why: measure the lack 意为“度量这处短缺”，1981 年那位守井人把村子里没有一位农人肯记载的一处短缺做了一遍。
lack 意为“缺乏；短缺”，指那种短缺本身而不是水桶，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被记载。
lack 意为“缺乏；短缺”，指村子里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的水桶。
lack 意为“缺乏；短缺”，指最远那口井台留给孩子们省下的那一滴那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lack 意为“惜护、节用”，指一件事里人人都省却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份惜护就是那件事的全部。
lack 意为“节用”，指人人都省却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种短缺，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lack 意为“缺乏；短缺”，指水账里写到、被记载的的那一种，到 1986 年这一种成了水账里的一行。
lack 意为“匮乏之事”，守井人六月写道，整件事的短缺之事是一处村子和三个夏天的记载。
lack 意为“缺乏；短缺”，我记得的是水账里记载过的那一种，1988 年记清了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一种。
lack 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，短缺是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的短缺。
